requirements.requirement: The system must execute an integration test that invokes evaluate_care_facade and retrieves clinical trial results including status score fields.
The system must validate that each clinical trial object in the facade response contains a non-null status_score field.
The system must verify that the status_score value matches the expected score derived from the underlying recruitment status for a RECRUITING trial.
The system must verify that the status_score value matches the expected score for a non-recruiting status (e.g., COMPLETED or TERMINATED).
The system must confirm that the facade response structure remains backward compatible with existing fields while including the status_score field.
The system must validate that the status_score field is of numeric type and falls within the normalized scoring range defined in the schema.
The system must ensure that the integration test covers at least one trial per major status category (RECRUITING, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING, COMPLETED, TERMINATED, UNKNOWN).
The system must assert that the clinical_trials_service is invoked during the integration test execution path.
The system must validate that the facade correctly maps internal status scoring output to the external API response field without transformation errors.
The system must handle the case where a clinical trial has a missing recruitment status by returning a valid default status_score in the response.
The system must handle the case where the clinical_trials_service returns an empty list by returning an empty response without errors and without status_score fields.
The system must fail the integration test if the status_score field is missing from any trial in the response payload.
The system must fail the integration test if any status_score value does not match the deterministic mapping defined in the scoring logic.
The system must execute the integration test within the backend test suite and ensure it passes in an isolated test environment.
